caption:
How to turn messy meeting notes into action items with AI

Meeting over, notes full of "who? me I guess" and "maybe Ali?". Here's the fix:

"Turn these meeting notes into 3 sections: DECISIONS (what we agreed), ACTIONS (task, owner, deadline), OPEN QUESTIONS (not decided yet). If an owner or deadline is missing, write NOT SET. Don't guess. Notes: [PASTE]"

Then: "Now write a short message for the team chat: one line per action, owner first. Then list what's still open."

I tried it on example notes from a café team meeting. It pulled out 2 decisions, 4 actions with owners, and flagged what was never decided instead of guessing.

The routine: paste right after the meeting, fill in every NOT SET, send the recap, open the next meeting with it.

Leave out anything private: pay, health or HR issues.
